# Motion fixture review evidence

The checked-in landing-sequence fixture is intentionally synthetic and exists to prove Identity's visual-motion contracts and quality integration.

Approved review boundaries for the fixture:

- `motion.meaning.identity-hero` — the sequence represents a purposeful brand reveal rather than decorative perpetual movement.
- `motion.direction.identity-hero` — the centered reveal preserves spatial continuity and does not contradict navigation or trigger origin.
- `visual.regression.identity-hero-motion` — the checked-in SVG baseline is the approved fixture projection.

This fixture is test evidence only; it is not a production animation or a replacement for consumer-owned creative intent.
